evidence.evidence_text: We consider the task of generating structured representations of text using large language models (LLMs).
In response, we present effective prompting strategies for both of these tasks.
To evaluate semantic coverage of generated structured representations we propose Auto-QA, and we verify the adequacy of Auto-QA using SQuAD dataset.

We introduce a taxonomy of problems around factuality, global and local structure, common to both modalities and propose a set of critiques to tackle these issues resulting in an absolute improvement in accuracy of +37pp (79%) for mind maps and +15pp (78%) for tables.
We further evaluate the usefulness of structured representations via a text comprehension user study.
